prompt: Your client is a cement manufacturer whose profits have fallen. Why?

clarifying.answer: A single grade of grey cement.

exhibits.title: Cost breakdown
exhibits.so_what: Freight is the largest and fastest-growing cost line.

phases.name: analysis
phases.interviewer_instructions: Reveal the cost exhibit when asked about costs.

coaching.explain: A strong candidate isolates whether the problem is revenue or cost.
coaching.model_approach_for_phase: Decompose profit into revenue and cost, then drill into cost lines.

common_errors.note: divided by cost instead of revenue

curveballs.injected_fact: Freight costs jump another 10% next quarter.

model_answer.framework: Profitability tree focused on the cost side.
key_insights: Freight is the dominant and rising cost.
model_answer.recommendation: Renegotiate freight contracts and consider rail.
model_answer.walkthrough: Profit fell because freight rose; revenue was stable.
